pr_title: fix: draft relations not being copied over when migrating to v5
pr_body:
### What does it do?

V5 Migration  is erasing some existing relations on the draft versions, but they are kept on the published ones.


### Related issue(s)/PR(s)

Fixes https://github.com/strapi/strapi/issues/21116

issue_context.title: [Migration] Relations in Published entries are not correctly migrated
issue_context.body: ## Bug report ### Required System information - Node.js version: v20.9.0 - Strapi version: from 4.25.9 to 5.0.0-rc.12 - Operating system: Windows using WSL ### Describe the bug WHen having a project in Strapi V4, migrating to V5 is erasing some existing relations for Published entries, displaying "No relations available" instead of the initially selected relation in the dropdown. Checked with @Marc-Roig already. ### Steps to reproduce the behavior 1. In a V4 Strapi project, create 2 collection types with a many-to-many relations between them. 2. Create entries for both collection types, including relations between them. 3. Publish at least on of these entries. 4. Migrate to V5 using npx @strapi/upgrade@rc to 5.0.0-rc.12 -c 5.0.0 5. Check your data when migration is done : for published enties, relations that were saved and published are not saved anymore, instead "no relations available" is displayed in the dropdown instead of the initially selected relation. ### Expected behavior Relations should remain the same for every entry when project is migrated to V5. ### Screenshots https://app.dashcam.io/replay/66d197d5d5ed02ddb9e9501e?share=2f91bIA15A6fz6Dccu1Wsg Published tab : Draft tab :

review_comments: you will need to do a 1st pass on all contenttypes to do the copyPublishedEntries 1st before running discardDraft on them as a 2nd pass :)
